turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you comfortable with how I am speaking?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Please talk a bit slower, my hearing is poor.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What brings you to the clinic today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Something is wrong with my chest, I think.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How would you describe what you feel in your chest?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is more of a dull ache.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When did you first notice it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It came on slowly last night.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you feel it in your left arm or in your jaw?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I feel it in my jaw sometimes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does doing chores around the house set it off?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, when I carry the laundry.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you taken anything for it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I took an antacid and it did not do anything.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you felt faint or dizzy?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Is your breathing affected?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A little bit, yes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you drenched or clammy during the episodes?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A little sweaty, yes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Let me ask about risk factors: tobacco, blood pressure, diabetes, cholesterol.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high cholesterol. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any heart problems in your close relatives?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My brother had bypass surgery.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have a history of heart surgery or stents?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Which pills do you take regularly?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Atorvastatin.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Let us wrap up with the plan. First, see the heart specialist within two weeks. Second, bring your medicine bottles to your next visit. Third, take one baby aspirin every morning. Can you repeat the plan in your own words for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will see the heart specialist in two weeks, bring my medicine bottles next time and take one baby aspirin each morning.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any other questions before you go?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nothing else, thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: All right, we are done. Take care of yourself.
